programs.description: After John Day and Maria lose their daughter in an accidental forest fire, it affects the mental health of Maria. Later, a courier person enters their home and abducts her.
Raj, a veterinarian from Mumbai, returns to his father's elephant reserve. There, he learns of a poaching operation being conducted and sets out to thwart them.
Aditya is trying to recover from his wife's betrayal and his physical disability. Meanwhile, Indrajeet Singh, a prince whose property was confiscated by Aditya's family, returns to exact revenge.
Bringing the best in television.
Veer and Geet fall in love and decide to marry but Veer messes up his first impression on Geet's father, causing further obstacles.
Ved Vyas Tripathi, a devout Hindu, is confronted with an identity crisis and an intellectual conflict when he learns he is actually a Muslim by birth.
Freddy, a shy dentist, falls for Kainaaz and agrees to help her kill her abusive husband. However, upon discovering that her plan all along was to use him, Freddy sets out to seek revenge.
Dhruv, who grew up an orphan, is in love with a woman who wishes to marry someone with a family. In order to fulfil his lover's wish, he hires two older individuals to pose as his parents.
Brothers, Vibhooti and Chiraunji, run an exorcism business and take advantage of people's superstition. However, things take a horrifying turn when they accept a case from Maya.
Tara, a woman from lower caste, aims at bringing a change in her community. So, she faces several challenges and eventually becomes the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh.
The retired con couple Bunty and Babli are forced to rejoin the business to thwart the attempts of a young duo that robs people with their trademark sigil and bring them to justice.
Indoo's one-night stand plans hit a snag after she discovers her charming partner's nationality and starts suspecting him of being a wanted terrorist.
Squadron Leader Vijay Karnik of the IAF races to conclude his task and shape history with the aid of 300 women during the 1971 Indo-Pakistani conflict.

Nandan, a middle-class man, is chased by a gangster, a corrupt politician and a cop when he finds a suitcase full of money.
Tara Shinde and Rakesh Dhawan lead the team of Indian scientists who work tirelessly to launch India's first satellite to Mars.
Hari, a curious pre-teen from Mumbai with a Hindu mother and Muslim father, vows to restore his father's shaken faith after a series of challenging events.
Laxman, a frail young man, has no other family members except Bharat, his younger brother. When Bharat is drafted into the army to fight a war between India and China, Laxman is left alone.
As a nod to the proverb fortune favours the brave, a ragtag team of heroes takes it upon themselves to apprehend one of India's most dreaded enemies.
During the Emergency, Indu's husband, a government employee, plans to use the situation to his advantage and move ahead in his career. However, Indu's sense of morality sets her on a different path.
Jolly, a struggling lawyer seeking success, comes upon a hit-and-run case and decides to fight for the victims. However, the defendant hires a proficient lawyer, Rajpal, to go against him.
Guddu, a reporter, falls in love with Rashmi and they begin a live-in relationship. However, their life turns chaotic when their families assume that they have eloped.
A determined young man sets out to fulfil his ambition of starting a low-cost airline. However, he soon finds himself embroiled in a high-stakes game of nefarious rivalry and bureaucracy.
Sardar sets out to avenge his father who was murdered by Ramadhir Singh, a cunning politician and mining kingpin. In the ensuing war, many unresolved family feuds erupt creating unrest.
Ashok and Kumar are best friends who live with Maamaji. Chaos ensues when Maamaji comes up with a series of plans to take Ashok's wealth that accidentally expose them to two sets of lookalikes.

Nakul, a 25-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend in jeopardy.
An Indian proprietor strives to sustain his enterprise against fierce global rivalry. Furthermore, he endeavours to compensate his family for lost time.
Ravi, the eldest of seven orphaned brothers, living in a farmhouse, marries Indu, a nurse. However, the brothers and their sister-in-law struggle to adjust with each other.
A lazy man must rise to the occasion when his brother lands in trouble. However, with two beautiful women chasing after him, the man struggles to make the right decisions.
When the woman he loves regrets a web transaction, a hacker decides to help her undo it. However, chaos ensues when he accidentally commits a robbery instead.
Samar, the son of a political family, has chosen to go to the USA to live with his girlfriend. However, the death of his father makes him put his plans on hold and enter the dirty world of politics.
Two newlyweds' lives turn upside down when they have a baby and find themselves struggling with the challenges of parenthood.
Karan and Rhea meet on a flight and end up hating each other at the end of their journey. Things change between them when they continue to bump into each other at different stages of their lives.
Mimi, a small-time dancer from Rajasthan, decides to lend her womb to a wealthy American couple to fund her lifelong dream of becoming a Bollywood actress.

Nikhil, a chef, falls for Ambar, a medical student, proposes to her, and eventually they move in together. However, their shared future faces an unforeseen challenge when Ambar discovers she is pregnant.

Rani is devastated after her fiancé leaves her just before the wedding. Undeterred, she decides to go on their honeymoon alone where she gets pulled out of her comfort zone and rediscovers herself.
After her father sells her sister to a local landlord, Sonia sets out on a mission to rescue her sister from international sex traffickers.

Sargam approaches Raj, a lawyer, to defend her friend Tarang, who is accused of murder. Raj proves that Tarang suffers from split personality but later, he learns that he might be the actual murderer.
A writer encounters her vital deadline during intense home chaos. Hence, she manages a swift sprint yet handles family crises.
Jaya, a former Kabaddi world champion, is pushed into making a comeback into the sport by her family. However, she first has to battle her internal conflicts and the expectations society has of her.
A Rajasthani father goes to extreme lengths to help a daughter pursue higher studies in London. Along the way, misadventures and misunderstandings put their relationship through its paces.
When Maya accuses Rahul, her CEO and mentor at the advertising agency, of sexual harassment, a committee is formed to offer them a platform to share their perspectives.

It's a story of a broken family, set in the world of mixed martial arts and underground street fighting. Gary Fernandes, a former alcoholic and street-fighter, returns home after serving a prison sentence of 10 long years. His two sons, David and Monty, who had parted ways as kids, are grown men now, but are still bitterly estranged. His elder son, David and his wife Jenny work hard to make ends meet and to provide the best for their ailing daughter.
Two brothers reunite when their grandfather suddenly falls ill. However, their reunion re-ignites past drama when they both fall for the same girl.
Friends Amar, Meet and Prem, who are unhappy with their married lives, decide to go for their college reunion to have fun. However, they get in trouble with the principal and a student.
Ashfaq, a self-centred and arrogant Bollywood star, must confront his own values when a murder accusation forces him to choose between maintaining his celebrity status and clearing his conscience.
Brothers Puran and Kala get their hands on an ancient Ayurvedic remedy that cures all illnesses. However, chaos ensues after Kala falls in love with a surgeon named Chiku.
A family wedding becomes a turning point for two couples from different generations to confront their misunderstandings, hidden affairs, and doubts that test their love and relationships.

Killed by accident due to a clerical error in heaven, Navin gets a second chance at life on Earth. However, since his body is unavailable, he must make a go of things in the body of his portly friend.
The desperate need for money drives Jerry into the world of drug peddling. However, when she tries to quit her dangerous job, her situation worsens.
In an extraordinary display of valour, resilience, and compassion, 22-year-old flight purser Neerja Bhanot puts her life on the line to save hundreds of passengers from hijackers.
Sikandar aspires to be a football player, but finds his life turned upside down when he falls into a trap of political warfare.
Malti falls victim to an acid attack and is forced to go through the ordeal of a court procedure while trying to heal mentally. Later, she decides to fight for justice for those like herself.
A young man tries to arrange a marriage for his brother, but finds himself falling in love with the chosen fiancée.
After being molested, Minal, along with her friends, tries to file an FIR against a politician's nephew. When the subsequent case gets rigged, Deepak, a retired lawyer, helps them to fight the case.
A single woman who dedicates her life to providing for her family must choose between her love and potential husband while grappling with marriage pressures.

Dev and Maya, who face struggles in their respective marriages, become friends. They try to help each other salvage their relationships but end up falling in love instead.
An archaeologist loses life to protect a map from a rival. In the journey to unlock the mysteries of the map, his two sons overcome death-defying obstacles.

Raju is hired to pose as uncle to three orphaned kids in order to usurp their inheritance. But he changes his mind after falling in love with their governess and decides to fight the greedy relatives.
After his son's death, Balraj attempts to convince his daughter-in-law Malvika to marry Rajat, her childhood friend. However, his endeavours are disregarded by his wife and elder brother.
Hemant Shah, a sharp-witted stockbroker, manipulates the system and goes from rags to riches in no time. Before long, journalist Meera starts digging into his activities.
Dia returns to her hometown to find her old dance theatre about to be demolished. Hoping to save it, she tries to involve the townsfolk in a dance performance.
The retired con couple Bunty and Babli are forced to rejoin the business to thwart the attempts of a young duo that robs people with their trademark sigil and bring them to justice.
A mathematician selects thirty underprivileged students and tutors them to pass one of the toughest entrance exams in India.
A group of college students are forced to take shelter in the mysterious Krishna Cottage for the night. Little do they know that a spirit haunts the house.

Despite facing a loss in the 1952 Summer Olympics, Coach Rahim builds a formidable football team and strives to bring glory to India.
Two brothers, Gollu and Pappu, confront Gustaad Khan, a terrorist, for blowing up their garage. However, he decides to take advantage of their innocence by making them deploy a bomb in Ludhiana.
Aditya finds himself on an island after surviving a shipwreck. Here, he realises he is a giant amongst its inhabitants, who think he is going to save them from a terrifying demon.
Eela Raiturkar, an aspiring singer, gives up on her career after her husband abandons her and their son, Vivaan. However, years later, he encourages his mother to pursue her dream.
Vikram, an Indian intelligence agent who visits Sri Lanka on a secret mission, finds himself embroiled in a civil war and a conspiracy to kill the former prime minister of India.
Nikhil is a struggling businessman who thinks he is in love with his girlfriend, Karishma, and wants to marry her. Instead, he ends up falling in love with her smart, geeky and quirky sister, Meeta.
RV, an up-and-coming car racer, suffers a devastating setback in his career due to an accident. When he loses everything, his family helps him conquer his demons and make a comeback.
Parma Chauhan and Zoya Qureshi are two rebellious individuals who belong to two rival political families. When they fall in love, their families set out to kill them.
When a financial crisis leaves Sameer and Nargis jobless, they resort to taking up a job in the Middle East. But when Nargis goes missing on arrival, Sameer sets out on a bloody quest to find her.
